# IntegerInput { #anylumino.IntegerInput }

```python
IntegerInput(
    value=0,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    min=None,
    max=None,
    step=1,
)
```

Integer text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default   |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| min | optional | Minimum numeric, date, or time value. | `None` |
| max | optional | Maximum numeric, date, or time value. | `None` |
| step | optional | Increment size. | `1` |
